description: This file defines various Grain interfaces, state management classes, and related patterns used in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes interfaces for grains with persistence, memory storage, different key types, error handling, user interaction, and state inheritance, as well as some data classes with serialization attributes.

classes.name: PersistenceTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a persistence-enabled grain, containing an integer, a string, and a sorted dictionary.

classes.name: MyPredicate
classes.description: Implementation of IMyPredicate with a filter value, providing a filtering function.

methods.name: GetServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the service identifier string.

methods.name: CheckStateInit
methods.description: Checks if the grain's state is initialized.

methods.name: CheckProviderType
methods.description: Returns the provider type as a string.

methods.name: DoSomething
methods.description: Performs an action, no return value.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Writes a value to the grain state.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Reads a value from the grain state.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Gets an integer value from the grain.

methods.name: DoDelete
methods.description: Deletes the grain state.

methods.name: GetStateAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the current state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetExtendedKeyValue
methods.description: Gets the extended key value for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Retrieves the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates user status.

methods.name: SetName

methods.name: AddFriend

methods.name: GetFriends
methods.description: Retrieves the list of friends.

methods.name: GetFriendsStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves the statuses of all friends.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Sets up the grain with another reentrant grain.

methods.name: Test1
methods.description: Performs reentrant test 1.

methods.name: Test2

methods.description: Delays task execution conditionally.
